visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with long wavy dark hair and a brownish-purple shirt is in a modern kitchen. He holds a glass of a pale green drink and a wooden spoon with light green sorbet, gesturing enthusiastically toward the camera. (2) The scene cuts to the interior of a FamilyMart refrigerator. A hand reaches in to show various products: a bottle of Sprite, a package of Lemon Guava Sorbet, a small bottle of vodka, Peach Black Tea, and Kirin Lemon ice drinks. (3) The man returns to the kitchen, preparing a drink. He adds ice cubes to a glass, then cuts the sorbet into small cubes and adds them. He pours Sprite over the ice and sorbet, then adds the Kirin Lemon drink. He stirs the mixture and tops it with more sorbet. (4) Close-up shots show the finished drink with a lime slice garnish. The man takes a sip and reacts with an exaggerated expression of delight, touching his face and smiling widely. (5) He demonstrates a second drink recipe. He adds ice to a glass, pours Peach Black Tea, adds vodka from a small bottle, and tops it with Yakult. (6) The man displays various Kirin-branded promotional items, including small glasses with cat-paw designs and a black thermal sleeve for cans. (7) A second man wearing a black cap enters the kitchen scene. He jokes with the first man and proceeds to pour multiple small bottles of vodka into the second glass. (8) A screen recording of the FamilyMart mobile app is shown, highlighting a specific campaign page. (9) Finally, the first man is back, holding a smartphone and the black thermal sleeve, explaining the promotional giveaway while gesturing excitedly.
